## Rodent Sightings in NYC from X - X year

### Motivation for Project
As students who are not native to New York, we have had encounters with rodents. These encounters pose significant health concerns to the residents on the city. Additionally, the city has uppened its efforts to decrease the rodent populations. However, we want to explore if there are any disparities among boroughs and zipcode areas in mitigating rodent prevalence. 

### Intended Final Products and Visualization

#### Home Page:
Describes the history and issue of rodents in NYC. 

#### Data Page
Visualization of the issue based on the data. 

Map of New York City across different years with the concentration of rodent complaints. 

Bar chart of complaints per borough.

Box Plot of the complaints by month/season 

Bar chart of zip codes by number of complaints.
